operation_details.item: The user always commits the entire campaign budget to a single channel with no testing, A/B splits, or cross-channel coordination.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! How's the campaign planning going for the new product launch?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Morning! It's going well. I've decided to put the entire budget into TikTok this time. No splits, just go all in.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Interesting approach. Have you considered running a small test first to see how the audience responds? That could help optimize the creative.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I know, but I really think TikTok is the way to go for our target demographic. I'd rather not dilute the impact.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I understand the appeal of a focused strategy. But even a small A/B test could give you insights without risking the whole budget.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Maybe you're right. I've been thinking about it. Actually, I'm considering a 70/30 split between TikTok and Instagram, with a test phase.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a more balanced plan. Let me know if you need help setting up the tracking.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thanks! I'll take you up on that. I'm also thinking about cross-channel coordination, maybe retargeting on email.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
